## Left open at serialize.java 2.1.2

2.1.1 applied reference v2.1.0's uniform rules U1 to U16 and fixed the 2026-10-27 audit findings for this port; 2.1.2 applied reference v2.1.1's rulings (U3, U6, U9, U15): SerializeUtil.copyString, the whole-operation room assertion on every write, and the U15 export list (test/serialize/tests/UniformRulesTests.java). One item stays open: the read slack contract, which waits on a measurement.

### Audit L: measure the read slack contract against the tail window reader

The BitReader accepts a tight array by copying the final bytes into a zero-padded tail window, and pays one branch per read to choose the array or the tail, slack or not; IMPLEMENTING.md's buffer contract calls that the slower correct option (speed rule). USAGE.md now states the contract the reader actually has (2.1.1). Same as serialize.js issue 22. Timing runs only on amd-3. Done when: the required-slack reader is measured against the tail window reader on amd-3, the faster one ships, and USAGE.md states its contract.
